results.title: Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma
results.original_title: Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma
results.overview: An ambitious director sets out to revive a faded slasher franchise, but her meeting with the film’s reclusive original star spirals into a terrifying maze of obsession, fear, and blood-soaked delusion.

results.title: The Odyssey
results.overview: After being falsely accused of treason by a jealous king, the legendary warrior Alexander is exiled to a forbidden monster filled realm and tasked with an impossible challenge: slay three ancient Titans or die trying. Armed with a mystical medallion, a legendary sword, and the help of unlikely allies, Alexander embarks on an epic quest to save the woman he loves, reclaim his honor, and prevent a tyrant from seizing his kingdom.

results.title: Way of the Warrior Kid
results.overview: Jake is an injured Navy SEAL who becomes a mentor for his shy, struggling nephew Marc. Using the principles of his military training, Jake teaches Marc how to be a Warrior Kid as he enters high school.

results.title: Apocalypse Z: New World
results.overview: The Canary Islands have become Europe’s last refuge following the outbreak of the TSJ virus. When a special mission sets out for the mainland in search of vital supplies, Roberto joins the team with questionable intentions. The dangerous operation turns into a desperate race for survival, and Roberto and his companions find themselves caught between hordes of infected and divided loyalties.

results.title: Asterix: The Kingdom of Nubia
results.overview: The irreductible Gauls are turned into harmless children after a rare youth elixir accidentally ends up into the magic potion. To find the antidote and save the village from the Romans attack, Asterix and Obelix embark on a crazy journey to the far away Kingdom of Nubia.

results.title: Cloud Girl
results.overview: The adventures of a young girl named Providence, who is entrusted with a magic quill that makes everything she writes come true. Faced with this incredible power, she has to choose between living her dreams and saving the world.

results.title: Appofeniacs
results.overview: When Duke goes on a frenzy of reckless deepfake creations, his callous disregard of consequences shows how, with a few clicks of an app on a phone, anyone can create a deceiving video of an unsuspecting victim and ruin their life… or end it.

results.title: Jailer 2
results.overview: When a dangerous syndicate threatens his family, retired jailer Tiger Muthuvel Pandian goes undercover as a driver to battle enemies from the shadows.

results.title: Sinners
results.overview: Trying to leave their troubled lives behind, twin brothers return to their hometown to start again, only to discover that an even greater evil is waiting to welcome them back.

results.title: Ice Cream Man
results.overview: An idyllic summer town descends into madness when an ice cream man serves kids sweet delights with horrifying results.

results.title: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie
results.overview: Having thwarted Bowser's previous plot to marry Princess Peach, Mario and Luigi now face a fresh threat in Bowser Jr., who is determined to liberate his father from captivity and restore the family legacy. Alongside companions new and old, the brothers travel across the stars to stop the young heir's crusade.

results.title: Citizen Vigilante
results.overview: A man takes justice into his own hands, hunting down criminals. His vigilante crusade makes him a social media star but puts him at odds with the local police chief.

results.title: The Cycle
results.overview: A daughter unravels her father's dark past after his body, missing for 36 years, is found at a horrific crime scene.

results.title: Tenzing
results.overview: A determined man embarks on a high-stakes quest—and defies seemingly impossible odds—to fulfill his dream of being the first to reach the summit of Mount Everest.

results.title: The Uprising
results.overview: As war and plague devastate 14th-century England, a humble peasant ignites a rebellion, uniting an army of commoners to defy the King’s might in a desperate fight for justice and survival.

results.title: Bad Apples
results.overview: A struggling primary school teacher is forced to take drastic action because of a foul-mouthed, violent student, and uncovers how her community will turn a blind eye to the most outrageous events to preserve harmony and their sense of safety.

results.title: Colony
results.overview: Professor Se-jeong is thrust into a bloody nightmare when a rapidly mutating virus is released during a biotech conference causing authorities to seal the facility. Trapped inside with no escape, Se-jeong along with a small group of survivors must fight to stay alive while the infected undergo horrific transformations.

results.title: The Gospel of Christmas
results.overview: A struggling pastor moves his family to a troubled New York neighborhood, where they must save a neglected church from foreclosure before Christmas.

results.title: The Good Lawyer
results.overview: After a courtroom overdose lands him in rehab, a lawyer has one week to save his career and prepare for his own trial, with the help of a dogged intern.

results.title: The Weight
results.overview: When Samuel is torn from his daughter and sent to a brutal prison, Warden Clancy offers him a high-stakes proposition: smuggle gold out of a remote mine with a dangerous crew of prisoners and he’ll win his freedom.
